description: This PHP class 'ResourceFetcher' fetches, caches, and processes oEmbed resources, supporting XML and JSON formats, and creates resource objects based on the fetched data.

classes.name: ResourceFetcher
classes.description: A class responsible for fetching, caching, and creating oEmbed resource objects from URLs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ResourceFetcher with HTTP client, provider repository, cache backend, and timeout.

methods.name: fetchResource
methods.description: Fetches an oEmbed resource from a URL, utilizing cache and handling XML/JSON parsing.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Creates a resource object from raw data and URL, validating version and type.

methods.name: parseResourceXml
methods.description: Parses XML data into an array, handling XML errors.
